svg.title: What a skill is made of, and when each part loads
svg.desc: Three layers. First, the name and description, about 100 tokens, which the assistant reads at the start of every chat to decide whether to use the skill. Second, the steps in the rest of SKILL.md, loaded only when the skill is used; keep it under 500 lines. Third, optional folders called references, scripts and assets, opened only if a step needs them.

g.text: Read at the start of every chat, about 100 tokens.
It decides whether the skill is used at all. Write it with care.
Loaded only when the skill is used.
Keep it under 500 lines. Plain Markdown, no fixed format.
references/ for long notes, scripts/ for code, assets/ for templates.
Opened only if a step needs them. Your first skill needs none.

svg.text: Based on the agentskills.io specification, November 2026.
